messages:
jen (capacity): Heads-up — monthly reserved GPU forecast shows an ~18% shortfall for hosted API in us-west-2 starting next month. Details: https://docs.internal/runs/forecast-q2 (spreadsheet linked).

mike (infra): Can you paste the top-line numbers?

jen (capacity): Committed capacity = 1,200 v100-equivalent GPU-hours/day. Expected demand (median) = 1,460. 95th percentile peak = 1,900. Shortfall ≈ 260 (median) / 700 (peak). Buffer currently 0.8 days at current autoscale.

sara (eng-fin): Oof. If we cover that with more reserved, finance needs ~2 weeks approval. Estimated incremental commit cost = ~$110k/mo for 300 GPUs reserved. Can we buy less and rely on cross-region routing?

ashley (sre): Are these sustained daytime increases or short spikes? If bursts, we can rely on burst credits + queued requests.

jen (capacity): Mostly sustained weekdays 09:00-18:00 PT; weekends normal. Brought up by new onboarding flows + analytics customers in US. Workload heatmap clipped in sheet.

capacity-bot: Autoscale alert — 17 new hosts launched in us-west-2 at 10:12 UTC; 95th utilization reached 78% for hosted-api-prod; estimated on-demand cost delta = $38,400/mo.

mike (infra): Two quick options:
1) Shift some non-latency-critical models for US traffic to eu-west-1 where we have spare reserved capacity (network egress + latency tradeoffs).
2) Add an incremental 300 GPU reserved commit in us-west-2 and enable gradual rollout.

jen (capacity): Quick sim results:
```
scenario A: +300 reserved in us-west-2 -> reduces on-demand hours by ~220 GPU-h/day -> net incremental cost +$86k/mo (after discounted rate)
scenario B: route 25% of low-priority traffic to eu-west-1 -> reduces us-west demand by ~180 GPU-h/day -> egress +$6k/mo, latency p95 +40ms for routed traffic
scenario C: enable model quantization for 2 large models -> reduces token compute ~12% -> saves ~90 GPU-h/day
```

sara (eng-fin): Mix of B + C looks cheapest while we wait for commit approval. Finance ok with temporary egress + performance hit if it's scoped to low-priority routes.

ashley (sre): Need an ops checklist before cross-region routing: certs, routing policy, monitoring adjustments, SLO carve-outs.

mike (infra): I'll draft a routing policy change and can toggle via feature flag to limit to low-priority customers.

jen (capacity): Action items:
- jen: open PR for commit delta proposal + attach cost sim (due EOD)
- mike: draft routing policy + feature flag (owning rollout)
- ashley: ops checklist + SLO caveat doc
- sara: start finance approval thread

sara (eng-fin): I'll set a 1hr sync tomorrow to sign off if PR looks good. :thumbsup:

mike (infra): Also flagging risk—if us-west demand keeps growing beyond current trend, we should plan runway for another +200 GPUs in Q3.

jen (capacity): Noted. I'll add growth scenario to the forecast and bump the runway projection.

capacity-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-1729 "US-WEST-2 reserved commit proposal" assigned to jen (capacity).

ashley (sre): cool. thanks everyone.
